description_for_human: One unified endpoint for AI agents to generate images, video, and audio from any provider. No API keys. No accounts. Just USDC.
description_for_model: UniGen API is a unified media generation gateway. It proxies requests to multiple AI providers for image, video, and audio generation. The agent specifies the provider and model; UniGen passes the request through without modification. Payment is USDC via x402 protocol. Endpoints: /v1/generate (create media), /v1/estimate (get cost/time/success rate before generating), /v1/capabilities (list providers and models), /v1/pricing (current prices), /v1/status (provider availability), /v1/balance (check USDC balance). UniGen does not select or recommend models. The agent decides.
